Mateo (Eng): Quick Q: staying in Berlin for 5 weeks (2027-09-10 to 2027-10-15) in a shared flat. Do we treat a flat-share receipt as proof for temporary remote? Also how will the monthly WFH stipend be handled if not a whole month?
Ruth (People Ops): Short answer: yes, booking/lease/airbnb receipts are fine for proof. For stipend we usually prorate by calendar days.
Oliver (Payroll): We'll do a day-pro-rata for the monthly stipend and add it to payroll as taxable earnings. For a 5-week stay across Sept/Oct, expect Sept prorate and a partial Oct entry. Exact amounts after form.
Hana (Tax): Germany doesn't trigger residency for a single 5-week stay, but keep docs. Employer reporting not expected. If you start doing customer meetings or extend beyond 90 days, ping tax@redwood.com.
Mateo (Eng): Got it. I have a 35-day Airbnb confirmation and an invoice for coworking. Is coworking reimbursable?
Ruth (People Ops): Coworking is usually an expense—submit via /expenses with receipts. Stipend covers general home office costs; coworking can be approved if it's work-related.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: Please complete /forms/temp-remote within 48h or People Ops will follow up. :memo:
Oliver (Payroll): Mateo, once you submit the form and address, payroll will schedule prorated stipend entries. We'll tag the record "temp Berlin 2027".
Mateo (Eng): Submitting form now. Also: do I need to change my home base?
Hana (Tax): No need for homebase change for <90 days. Just log it. Keep travel docs and calendar entries in case auditors ask.
Ruth (People Ops): Approved provisional pending form. We'll close when payroll confirms stipend entries. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
